item.description:
I bring to you the available dubs for Grachi's first episode (The Girl of the Butterflies) from Season 1.
One file has the Spanish, Portuguese & Italian audios, you gotta open the file on VLC to choose your language.
Russian & Polish dubbings are separated in one single file.

Spanish: La Chica de las Mariposas
Brazilian Portuguese: A Garota das Borboletas
